reds.match: libs/ui/tests-components/carousel.test.ts > carousel: HeroUI CSS applied; no engine before interaction on the static carousels
reds.reason: derived resume granularity: the autoplay `#ca-auto` boots at load (`data-boot`), and its `onSelect` handler prop (a non-data prop) makes its record adopt with its parent, so the route unit re-runs and every cdk Carousel on the page (`#ca-basic`, `#ca-thumbs`) starts its engine before any interaction (REDS-UI 2026-10-28)
reds.owner: runtime / compiler (RED-COMP: standalone adopt of a woken child with handler props)

reds.match: libs/ui/tests-components/data-grid.test.ts > data-grid: resumed sort + selection keep the server rows; keyboard after resume
reds.reason: derived adopt mismatch: in `<tbody>` the empty server branch region of the top spacer `<Show>` (`<!--[--><!--r0[--><!--]--><!--]-->`, Show false) is claimable by the following `<For>` hole (`R_OPEN`), so the For claims it as its first row group and fails at the `]` marker; the cdk DataGrid boundary renders afresh in the browser (dev: 'did not adopt its server markup: <tbody> children'), re-creating every row (REDS-UI 2026-10-28)
reds.owner: runtime (RED-COMP: dom-derived alignUnit / claim of a For after a false Show)

reds.match: libs/ui/tests-components/data-grid.test.ts > data-grid: virtualized 10k rows scroll swaps the window; sort on 10k
reds.reason: same derived adopt mismatch as the sort case (Show-false region claimed by the For hole): the first (held) scroll adopts by rendering the grid afresh, the new scroll container starts at scrollTop 0, so the window never reaches row 5000; a second scroll works (REDS-UI 2026-10-28)
reds.owner: runtime (RED-COMP: dom-derived alignUnit / claim of a For after a false Show)

reds.match: libs/ui/tests-components/navbar.test.ts > navbar: first press on a slow network is fast (handler chunks prefetched while visible)
reds.reason: router build: the first press imports the route page module through the App's `__vitePreload`, whose deps list the component CSS chunks (navbar / separator / morph-icon .css) that the page already has inside its merged `route-*.css`; Vite injects them under their own hrefs and waits for them: +1 round trip (~580 ms at 400 ms latency) on every resumed page's first interaction, and the re-appended sheets reorder the cascade (data-grid pinned cells, fixed by specificity TW-180) (REDS-UI 2026-10-28)
reds.owner: router (route CSS vs Vite CSS preload deps: `libs/router/build/vite.ts` preloadDeps / route-css.ts)

reds.match: libs/cdk/tests-components/drag-drop-resume.test.ts > nothing drag-drop related loads before the lists are visible; scrolling them in preloads it
reds.reason: derived resume: the story's `export const preload = "visible"` is ignored under derived (compiler CLAUDE.md) and there is no derived visible prefetch for boundaries, so nothing loads on scroll-in on the lean story page. Needs a ruling: port visible prefetch to derived, or drop the contract + these tests (triaged REDS-CDK 2026-10-28)

reds.match: libs/cdk/tests-components/drag-drop-resume.test.ts > first drag after the visible preload starts synchronously; the drop reports the new index
reds.reason: derived resume: no visible prefetch under derived (see the sibling entry), so the first drag replays asynchronously after the chunk loads instead of starting synchronously. Same ruling needed (triaged REDS-CDK 2026-10-28)

reds.match: libs/cdk/tests-components/resizable.test.ts > cold: the imperative panel ref collapses; a drag persists the layout to the cookie, server-rendered on reload
reds.reason: derived resume (RED-COMP / compiler facts): the story's button click does not adopt the Group (record flags 262, DEFER) / Panel, so `leftRef.current` is null on the first click; `usePanelRef` returns a plain-data object, so the dependency facts cannot see the mutable ref the handler reads. Needs a compiler / server-facts change (triaged REDS-CDK 2026-10-28)

reds.match: libs/cdk/tests-components/select.test.ts > focus events fire once per focus, not when the listbox takes focus; data-focused stays while open
reds.reason: derived resume (RED-COMP): a cold programmatic / fast-Tab focus on the Select trigger is not held by the loader (`focus` not in the trigger's `data-events`; `_rListens` deliberately does not widen to focus/blur, protects Select typeahead), so onFocus is lost before the unit adopts. Triaged REDS-CDK 2026-10-28; a Tab-focus test variant fails the same way
